defects.finding: The guide does not carry the route’s declared pre-filing participant evidence: conditional PennDOT driver history establishing completed suspension and checking/correcting that answer, and the Pennsylvania State Police report obtained within 60 days with acquisition/attachment instructions. It also does not collect or disclose the route’s current-age, age-at-offense, complete-sentence and license-suspension questions. The official petition’s attachment statement survives visually, but that does not satisfy the requirement to name every declared item in participant-instructions.md. Preserving 116 existing field-map declarations does not establish whole-route completeness.
defects.repairRequirement: Carry the existing governed questions and required/conditional evidence into the participant flow and guide, preserving conditionality and LegalEase’s no-authentication role for the outside record.

defects.finding: The guide says to confirm filing destination and discusses court level, but never states the governed destination: clerk of the courts of the judicial district in which the charges were disposed. A passing vehicle selection does not tell the participant where to file.
defects.repairRequirement: State the named clerk and disposed-case judicial district from the existing route record; retain the documented court-level selection and unknown-court stop.

defects.finding: The guide only says to confirm fees. It omits both already-governed answers: county filing fees vary with no confirmed statewide schedule, and in forma pauperis relief is available on statewide forms. This is missing existing source-backed guidance, not an invitation to invent a fee amount.
defects.repairRequirement: State county variability and the IFP waiver route, with local clerk confirmation for the amount and procedure.

defects.finding: None of the three governed stop conditions appears in the guide: unfinished license suspension, any other unsatisfied sentence condition, or participant under 21. The guide’s correct unknown-court-level stop is retained but does not replace these conditions.
defects.repairRequirement: Carry all three existing route stops into participant-facing instructions, including the commonly overlooked license suspension.

secondaryFindings.finding: The canonical proposed order’s SpecificCharges field visibly says Possession of a controlled substance, and the boundary facts carry a longer version of that drug charge. These are generic layout fixtures, not demonstrations of a qualifying §6308 alcohol conviction. Court-level vehicle selection is tested, but no valid underage-route factual example or satisfaction of its eligibility conditions is established. This limitation is not treated as a new legal conclusion about a real participant.
